name: Greek Roast Lamb
author: The Wickham family

ingredients.item: 1 head garlic divided into cloves but unpeeled
Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Put lamb in roasting pan and scatter garlic cloves around.
Pour over juice and wine and arrange rosemary sprigs on top.
Remove from oven and reduce temperature to 140C.
Squeeze garlic from 4 cloves and spread on top of lamb. (Remove other cloves to use some other time.)
Mix together vegetables and place around lamb.
Make an airtight tent over the pan with foil and return to bake for a further 1 1/2 hours.
Alternatively place all in a large covered casserole dish.
WW 5 points per serve of 125g meat per person.
